# cubepath_vps_templates (Data Source)

Fetches the list of available VPS operating system templates.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier.
- `templates` (Attributes List) List of available VPS templates. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--templates))

<a id="nestedatt--templates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `templates`

Read-Only:

- `os_name` (String) The operating system name.
- `template_name` (String) The template identifier (e.g., 'debian-12').
- `version` (String) The OS version.
